## 8. What rotor area, thrust and storage mass can be built?

These plans close only in the quasi-static force-and-bus model. Vertical dynamics, suspended-load control and sufficient stored energy for mission completion remain unestablished. Rotor energy and power figures are conditional on a constant hover merit times drive efficiency at every thrust and speed, with no separate blade profile power and no specified blade, rotor-speed or pitch policy. A separated model can move these figures in either direction. What evidence supports the installed disk area, downward-only thrust and battery rating together? Can any required storage mass fit inside the dry-mass target?

## Rotor-efficiency range

Hold-down descent is priced as climb, on the conservative side; climb against hold-down thrust is priced as level flight, with no bound claimed.

requirements.existing_boundary: Configured aggregate diskM2 and station-count fields are stipulations, not selected blades or a measured installation. Rotor/station/coaxial counts must use the same configuration boundary.
prospective_observations: Installed rotor disk and station geometry; blade/hub/drive arrangement, clearances, mounts and hull-relative location; rotor speed/pitch policy
requirements.prospective_custodian_role: Rotor geometry and installation evidence custodian
requirements.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; no new numeric threshold selected
requirements.disconfirming_or_insufficient_evidence: Nominal disk area or a viewer depiction alone cannot establish installed usable area, coupled flow or a buildable article.

requirements.existing_boundary: The explicit unverified installed-thrust surrogate inverts hover power at existing battery plus generator rating. Actual bus allocation separately prices non-rotor loads; neither is a blade thrust rating. Downward-only force authority and missing upward authority remain distinct.
prospective_observations: Matched directional force and moment history, blade speed/pitch, shaft and electrical power, local pressure/density/temperature, axial/cross-flow and coupled coaxial/hull wake; transient gimbal and thrust response
requirements.prospective_custodian_role: Rotor performance and flight-controls evidence custodian
requirements.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; no new numeric threshold selected
requirements.disconfirming_or_insufficient_evidence: Power-derived thrust capacity or quasi-static closure does not establish measured thrust authority, transient control or physical capability.

requirements.existing_boundary: Constant hover merit times drive efficiency is used at every thrust/speed, with no separate blade profile power or specified rotor-speed/pitch policy. Separating those terms can change printed figures in either direction.
prospective_observations: Matched electrical input, shaft output and aerodynamic force at declared operating states; complete motor/drive cooling and derating boundary at the relevant ambient state
requirements.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; no new numeric threshold selected
requirements.disconfirming_or_insufficient_evidence: A component efficiency or sea-level rating cannot qualify the complete installation across states or fill the missing blade-profile contribution.

requirements.existing_boundary: Configured battMWh/battMW and existing specific-energy cases are assumptions/reference evidence. The existing requirement tables retain the class energy-to-peak-power ratio: power alone does not fix storage mass. Quasi-static force/bus closure does not establish sufficient stored energy for mission completion.
prospective_observations: Complete installed pack mass and inclusion inventory; usable energy and delivery history with initial/final state of charge, thermal/protection limits, losses, reserve convention and matched duty
requirements.prospective_custodian_role: Battery-pack and complete-equipment mass evidence custodians
requirements.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; no new numeric threshold selected
requirements.disconfirming_or_insufficient_evidence: A cell specific energy, peak rating, or old conditional closing table cannot establish usable installed storage or a complete mission.

requirements.existing_boundary: The battery comparison is pack-specific; the dry target is the whole non-water allowance. Existing mass-budget failures and source qualifications are retained. Requirement rows are not hardware options.
prospective_observations: Weighed installed rotor/blade/hub/motor/drive, cabling/protection/cooling/mount/control and storage inventory with exclusions; other aircraft structure, plant/tank and equipment accounted separately; contents distinguished from tankage
requirements.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; no new numeric threshold selected
requirements.disconfirming_or_insufficient_evidence: Selected component masses or a favourable policy column do not establish complete equipment or whole dry-mass closure.

evidence_boundaries: Model requirement values are not observations or qualified articles.
Published rounded closing rows remain conditional quasi-static force/bus records; no table is regenerated or new sizing estimate made.
The source documents keep rotor, vertical dynamics, suspended-load control and stored-energy limitations explicit.
Existing floor/credible/demonstrated source-policy cases retain their original evidence qualifications; demonstrated is not a complete qualified airship.
